name: 新建
task: Create a new task by filling out the "Add Task" form and submitting it.
expected_result: The new task appears in the list of to-do items with the correct details and is visible under the user's account.

name: 编辑
task: Edit an existing task by changing its description and saving the changes.
expected_result: The task's description is updated in the list and reflects the changes accurately.

name: 标记完成
task: Mark a specific task as completed on the to-do list.
expected_result: The task is visibly marked as completed, often indicated by a strikethrough, checkbox, or similar visual cue.

name: 删除
task: Delete a task from the list by selecting the "Delete" option next to it.
expected_result: The selected task is removed from the list and is no longer visible in the account.

name: 搜索
task: Use the search functionality to find a specific task by its title or keywords.
expected_result: The search returns a relevant list of tasks that match the query, displaying intended search criteria clearly.

name: 按完成状态筛选
task: Filter tasks to show only completed or uncompleted tasks.
expected_result: The task list updates to display only tasks that match the selected filter criteria without affecting the unfiltered tasks' status.

name: 页面导航
task: Verify the site's navigation by clicking the provided menu items or links in the user interface.
expected_result: Each navigation element correctly redirects the user to the intended page without errors, maintaining user session details.

name: 配色
task: Verify that the website uses 'lavender' as the background color and 'indigo' as the component color, as specified in the design requirements.
expected_result: The website has a background color of 'lavender' and components (such as buttons, cards, headers, etc.) are styled with the color 'indigo', accurately reflecting the design instruction.
